units.source_text: 实际上，人们“啊”地一声倒抽一口冷气和驹子“啊”地一声惊叫，都是在同一瞬间发生的。

en.t: In fact, the people gasping “ah” and Komako crying out “ah” both happened at the very same instant.

units.source_text: 叶子的腿肚子在地上痉挛，似乎也是在这同一刹那。

en.t: Yoko’s calf convulsing on the ground seemed to have happened in that very same instant as well.
